command: cd /workspace/pr && git -C . diff --no-index --stat base head 2>/dev/null | tail -80 || true; echo ----; grep '^diff --git' head.diff | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's|^a/||' > /tmp/files.txt; for f in $(cat /tmp/files.txt); do if [ -f "base/$f" ]; then printf "M "; else printf "A "; fi; wc -l "head/$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%6s ", $1}'; echo "$f"; done
